newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS OVERTAKE BARCELONA TO GO SECOND IN SPAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS OVERTAKE BARCELONA TO GO SECOND IN SPAIN.

text.p: Real Betis overtook Barcelona to move into second place in the Spanish first division on Saturday after cruising to a 4-0 victory over Oviedo.

The result left Betis six points behind Real Madrid and three ahead of Barcelona. Leaders Real play Zaragoza on Sunday, while Barcelona face Sevilla in a game they must win by at least two goals to recapture second place on goal difference.
International striker Alfonso Perez was one of the Betis scorers and joined Barcelona's Brazilian prodigy Ronaldo at the top of the Spanish scoring list with 22 goals.

Betis chairman Manuel Ruiz de Lopera refused to allow television cameras into the game and may face a fine of over 200 million pesetas ($1.39 million) after leaving Spanish fans without a Saturday evening televised game on a league weekend for the first time in seven years.
